import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"ppo_epochs": 2, "n_envs": 128, "rollout_len": 16, "n_minibatches": 16, "lr": 0.001, "ent_coef": 0.005}

STEM = 64
COL = 48
WIDTH = 40
PROJ = 32
HID = 32


class PoolHead(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, footprints, proj, hid):
        super().__init__()
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in footprints]
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(c, proj, 1)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * proj, hid, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(hid, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])

    def forward(self, f):
        p = self.proj(f)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = p, p, p
            else:
                q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            h = F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1)))
            res.append(out(h))
        return torch.cat(res, dim=1).flatten(1)


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(STEM, COL, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(COL, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.head = PoolHead(WIDTH, spec.footprints, PROJ, HID)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * WIDTH, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        s = self.stem(obs)
        x = F.relu(self.c1(s))
        f = F.relu(x + self.c2(x))
        place = self.head(f)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

import torch

import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"ppo_epochs": 2, "n_envs": 128, "rollout_len": 16, "n_minibatches": 16, "lr": 0.001, "ent_coef": 0.005}

E = 16
H = 24
T = 32


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.Z = int(spec.Z)
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in spec.footprints]
        self.layer_enc = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(12, E, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(E, E, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.trunk = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels, T, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(T, T, 3, padding=1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(T, T, 3, padding=1), nn.ReLU())
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * E, H, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.ctx = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(T, H, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(H, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * T + E, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        B, C, Y, X = obs.shape
        Z = self.Z
        b = obs[:, 0:Z]
        t = obs[:, Z:2 * Z]
        m = obs[:, 2 * Z:3 * Z]
        e = obs[:, 3 * Z:4 * Z]
        cur = torch.stack([b, t, m, e], dim=2)
        below = F.pad(cur, (0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 1, 0))[:, :Z]
        gl = obs[:, 4 * Z:4 * Z + 3].unsqueeze(1).expand(B, Z, 3, Y, X)
        zc = (torch.arange(Z, device=obs.device, dtype=obs.dtype) / Z).view(1, Z, 1, 1, 1).expand(B, Z, 1, Y, X)
        x = torch.cat([cur, below, gl, zc], dim=2).reshape(B * Z, 12, Y, X)
        h = self.layer_enc(x)
        tr = self.trunk(obs)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, ctx, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.ctx, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = h, h, h
            else:
                q = F.pad(h, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            c = ctx(tr).unsqueeze(1).expand(B, Z, H, Y, X).reshape(B * Z, H, Y, X)
            u = F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1)) + c)
            s = out(u).view(B, Z, Y, X).sum(1)
            res.append(s)
        place = torch.stack(res, dim=1).flatten(1)
        hm = h.view(B, Z, E, Y, X).mean((1, 3, 4))
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([tr.mean((2, 3)), tr.amax((2, 3)), hm], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)

    return Net(spec)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"ppo_epochs": 1, "n_envs": 64, "rollout_len": 16, "n_minibatches": 16, "lr": 0.001, "ent_coef": 0.003, "gamma": 0.97, "gae_lambda": 0.95}

E = 16
H = 20
T = 24


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.Z = int(spec.Z)
        C = int(spec.in_channels)
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in spec.footprints]
        self.enc_layer = nn.Conv2d(8 + self.Z, E, 1)
        self.enc_col = nn.Conv2d(C, E, 1)
        self.enc2 = nn.Conv2d(E, E, 1)
        self.trunk = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(C, T, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(T, T, 3, padding=1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(T, T, 3, padding=1), nn.ReLU())
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * E, H, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.ctx = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(T, H, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(H, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * T + E, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        B, C, Y, X = obs.shape
        Z = self.Z
        b = obs[:, 0:Z]
        t = obs[:, Z:2 * Z]
        m = obs[:, 2 * Z:3 * Z]
        e = obs[:, 3 * Z:4 * Z]
        cur = torch.stack([b, t, m, e], dim=2)
        below = F.pad(cur, (0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 1, 0))[:, :Z]
        zoh = torch.eye(Z, device=obs.device, dtype=obs.dtype).view(1, Z, Z, 1, 1).expand(B, Z, Z, Y, X)
        xl = torch.cat([cur, below, zoh], dim=2).reshape(B * Z, 8 + Z, Y, X)
        a = self.enc_layer(xl).view(B, Z, E, Y, X) + self.enc_col(obs).unsqueeze(1)
        h = F.relu(a).reshape(B * Z, E, Y, X)
        h = F.relu(self.enc2(h))
        tr = self.trunk(obs)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, ctx, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.ctx, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = h, h, h
            else:
                q = F.pad(h, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            c = ctx(tr).unsqueeze(1).expand(B, Z, H, Y, X).reshape(B * Z, H, Y, X)
            u = F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1)) + c)
            s = out(u).view(B, Z, Y, X).sum(1)
            res.append(s)
        place = torch.stack(res, dim=1).flatten(1)
        hm = h.view(B, Z, E, Y, X).amax(1).mean((2, 3))
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([tr.mean((2, 3)), tr.amax((2, 3)), hm], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"ppo_epochs": 1, "n_envs": 64, "rollout_len": 16, "n_minibatches": 16, "lr": 0.001, "ent_coef": 0.003, "gamma": 0.97, "gae_lambda": 0.95}

STEM = 64
W = 40


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.nt = int(spec.n_types)
        self.n_place = int(spec.n_place)
        fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in spec.footprints]
        k = 2 * max(max(a, b) for a, b in fps) - 1
        if k < 3:
            k = 3
        cin = int(spec.in_channels) + self.nt + 2
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(cin, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(STEM, W, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(W, W, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(W, W, 3, padding=1)
        self.c3 = nn.Conv2d(W, W, 3, padding=1)
        self.pout = nn.Conv2d(W, self.nt, k, padding=k // 2)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * W, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        B, C, Y, X = obs.shape
        mp = mask[:, :self.n_place].to(obs.dtype).reshape(B, self.nt, Y, X)
        ys = torch.linspace(-1.0, 1.0, Y, device=obs.device, dtype=obs.dtype).view(1, 1, Y, 1).expand(B, 1, Y, X)
        xs = torch.linspace(-1.0, 1.0, X, device=obs.device, dtype=obs.dtype).view(1, 1, 1, X).expand(B, 1, Y, X)
        x = torch.cat([obs, mp, ys, xs], dim=1)
        s = self.stem(x)
        f = F.relu(s + self.c1(s))
        f = F.relu(f + self.c2(f))
        f = F.relu(f + self.c3(f))
        place = self.pout(f)[:, :, :Y, :X].flatten(1)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

import math
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"ppo_epochs": 1, "n_envs": 128, "rollout_len": 16, "n_minibatches": 8, "lr": 0.0005, "ent_coef": 0.01, "gamma": 0.99, "gae_lambda": 0.95}

D = 64
NH = 4
FF = 128
NL = 2


class Block(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.n1 = nn.LayerNorm(D)
        self.qkv = nn.Linear(D, 3 * D)
        self.o = nn.Linear(D, D)
        self.n2 = nn.LayerNorm(D)
        self.f1 = nn.Linear(D, FF)
        self.f2 = nn.Linear(FF, D)

    def forward(self, x):
        B, N, _ = x.shape
        qkv = self.qkv(self.n1(x)).view(B, N, 3, NH, D // NH).permute(2, 0, 3, 1, 4)
        q = qkv[0]
        k = qkv[1]
        v = qkv[2]
        a = torch.softmax(torch.matmul(q, k.transpose(-1, -2)) / math.sqrt(D // NH), dim=-1)
        y = torch.matmul(a, v).transpose(1, 2).reshape(B, N, D)
        x = x + self.o(y)
        x = x + self.f2(F.relu(self.f1(self.n2(x))))
        return x


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.Y = int(spec.Y)
        self.X = int(spec.X)
        self.nt = int(spec.n_types)
        self.n_place = int(spec.n_place)
        cin = int(spec.in_channels) + self.nt
        self.embed = nn.Linear(cin, D)
        self.row = nn.Parameter(torch.randn(self.Y, D) * 0.02)
        self.col = nn.Parameter(torch.randn(self.X, D) * 0.02)
        self.cls = nn.Parameter(torch.randn(1, 1, D) * 0.02)
        self.blocks = nn.ModuleList([Block() for _ in range(NL)])
        self.nf = nn.LayerNorm(D)
        self.place = nn.Linear(D, self.nt)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * D, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        B, C, Y, X = obs.shape
        mp = mask[:, :self.n_place].to(obs.dtype).reshape(B, self.nt, Y, X)
        x = torch.cat([obs, mp], dim=1).flatten(2).transpose(1, 2)
        pos = (self.row.view(Y, 1, D) + self.col.view(1, X, D)).reshape(1, Y * X, D)
        t = self.embed(x) + pos
        t = torch.cat([self.cls.expand(B, 1, D), t], dim=1)
        for blk in self.blocks:
            t = blk(t)
        t = self.nf(t)
        cell = t[:, 1:]
        place = self.place(cell).transpose(1, 2).reshape(B, -1)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([t[:, 0], cell.mean(1)], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"ppo_epochs": 1, "n_envs": 128, "rollout_len": 16, "n_minibatches": 8, "lr": 0.001, "ent_coef": 0.01, "gamma": 0.99, "gae_lambda": 0.95}

STEM = 64
W = 40
DC = 8
DH = 256


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.nt = int(spec.n_types)
        self.n_place = int(spec.n_place)
        Y = int(spec.Y)
        X = int(spec.X)
        fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in spec.footprints]
        k = 2 * max(max(a, b) for a, b in fps) - 1
        if k < 3:
            k = 3
        cin = int(spec.in_channels) + self.nt + 2
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(cin, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(STEM, W, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(W, W, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(W, W, 3, padding=1)
        self.c3 = nn.Conv2d(W, W, 3, padding=1)
        self.pout = nn.Conv2d(W, self.nt, k, padding=k // 2)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * W, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.dred = nn.Conv2d(W, DC, 1)
        self.dense = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(DC * Y * X + 64, DH), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Linear(DH, int(spec.n_actions)))

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        B, C, Y, X = obs.shape
        mp = mask[:, :self.n_place].to(obs.dtype).reshape(B, self.nt, Y, X)
        ys = torch.linspace(-1.0, 1.0, Y, device=obs.device, dtype=obs.dtype).view(1, 1, Y, 1).expand(B, 1, Y, X)
        xs = torch.linspace(-1.0, 1.0, X, device=obs.device, dtype=obs.dtype).view(1, 1, 1, X).expand(B, 1, Y, X)
        x = torch.cat([obs, mp, ys, xs], dim=1)
        s = self.stem(x)
        f = F.relu(s + self.c1(s))
        f = F.relu(f + self.c2(f))
        f = F.relu(f + self.c3(f))
        place = self.pout(f)[:, :, :Y, :X].flatten(1)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        base = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        d = F.relu(self.dred(f)).flatten(1)
        logits = base + self.dense(torch.cat([d, g], dim=1))
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"ppo_epochs": 1, "n_envs": 128, "rollout_len": 16, "n_minibatches": 8, "lr": 0.001, "ent_coef": 0.01, "gamma": 0.99, "gae_lambda": 0.95}

STEM = 64
COL = 48
WIDTH = 40
PROJ = 32
HID = 32


class PoolHead(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, footprints, proj, hid):
        super().__init__()
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in footprints]
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(c, proj, 1)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * proj, hid, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(hid, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])

    def forward(self, f):
        p = self.proj(f)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = p, p, p
            else:
                q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            h = F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1)))
            res.append(out(h))
        return torch.cat(res, dim=1).flatten(1)


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(STEM, COL, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(COL, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.head = PoolHead(WIDTH, spec.footprints, PROJ, HID)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * WIDTH, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        s = self.stem(obs)
        x = F.relu(self.c1(s))
        f = F.relu(x + self.c2(x))
        place = self.head(f)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

class PoolHead(nn.Module):

        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(hid, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])

    def forward(self, f):

        res = []

            nn.Conv2d(STEM, COL, 1), nn.ReLU())

            nn.Conv2d(CW, CW, 3, padding=1), nn.ReLU())

        f = F.relu(x + self.c2(x))

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"ppo_epochs": 1, "n_envs": 256, "rollout_len": 16, "n_minibatches": 16, "lr": 0.001, "ent_coef": 0.002, "gamma": 0.9, "gae_lambda": 0.8}

E = 16
H = 24
T = 32


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.Z = int(spec.Z)
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in spec.footprints]
        self.layer_enc = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(12, E, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(E, E, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.trunk = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels, T, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(T, T, 3, padding=1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(T, T, 3, padding=1), nn.ReLU())
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * E, H, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.ctx = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(T, H, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(H, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * T + E, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        B, C, Y, X = obs.shape
        Z = self.Z
        b = obs[:, 0:Z]
        t = obs[:, Z:2 * Z]
        m = obs[:, 2 * Z:3 * Z]
        e = obs[:, 3 * Z:4 * Z]
        cur = torch.stack([b, t, m, e], dim=2)
        below = F.pad(cur, (0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 1, 0))[:, :Z]
        gl = obs[:, 4 * Z:4 * Z + 3].unsqueeze(1).expand(B, Z, 3, Y, X)
        zc = (torch.arange(Z, device=obs.device, dtype=obs.dtype) / Z).view(1, Z, 1, 1, 1).expand(B, Z, 1, Y, X)
        x = torch.cat([cur, below, gl, zc], dim=2).reshape(B * Z, 12, Y, X)
        h = self.layer_enc(x)
        tr = self.trunk(obs)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, ctx, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.ctx, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = h, h, h
            else:
                q = F.pad(h, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            c = ctx(tr).unsqueeze(1).expand(B, Z, H, Y, X).reshape(B * Z, H, Y, X)
            u = F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1)) + c)
            s = out(u).view(B, Z, Y, X).sum(1)
            res.append(s)
        place = torch.stack(res, dim=1).flatten(1)
        hm = h.view(B, Z, E, Y, X).mean((1, 3, 4))
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([tr.mean((2, 3)), tr.amax((2, 3)), hm], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

analyses.1: There are no trials yet. The starting architecture scored 0.000 on both seeds, so any non-zero score is useful signal. The default budget allows only 131k steps, which is 32 PPO updates, and that is likely too few. A faster recipe (fewer epochs, which buys more samples, and smaller batches, which buy more updates) may matter as much as the network. On structure: a placement is right when the brick's landing layer, which is the maximum build height under its footprint, matches target cells that are still missing at that layer across the whole footprint. The starting network mixes all layers in one 1x1 stem before pooling over the footprint, so it cannot easily reason per layer. The three candidates are set up as a small factorial test. A is the starting network with the faster recipe. B is a layer-resolved head with the same recipe, so A against B measures the architecture. C is the same layer-resolved head with a 1-epoch, higher-learning-rate recipe, so B against C measures the recipe.
analyses.2: All four runs so far score 0, including the starting architecture, and so does training success. Changing epochs (4, 2 or 1) and adding the layer-resolved footprint head both left the score at 0, so neither the recipe nor the architecture is shown to matter yet. The step count is capped at about 426k, reached with 1 epoch and a network no costlier than the starting one, so better use of each sample is the main lever left. n_minibatches does not count toward compute. Small minibatches and fewer envs give about 4x more gradient steps for free. Two more possibilities are open. The dense reward favours filling cells over exact builds, and a lower entropy bonus with a longer horizon may help exact builds appear. The world note may also mean the footprint or anchor rule differs from the description, which would make the hand-aligned pooling windows wrong. This round tests one recipe change and two architectures under that recipe: one with column context added, and one that assumes no footprint convention.
analyses.3: All six trials score exactly 0 on dev and 0 in training, across both seeds. The variations covered 1 to 2 PPO epochs, 64 to 128 envs, gamma 0.95 to 0.97, entropy 0.003 to 0.005, footprint-pooling heads, layer-resolved heads and a convention-free CNN. So none of these changes had a visible effect. Seed noise cannot explain this pattern; the agents are not learning to finish builds at all. Two recipe axes are still untested: long-horizon credit (gamma 0.99 for the +1 exact-build bonus that comes after up to 33 steps) and stronger exploration. Two architecture ideas are also untested: global relational reasoning, and output wiring that does not assume the stated action-index or DONE layout, in case this world differs. This round tests all of these. Candidate 3 is a control: the starting network with the new shared recipe. If it alone moves, the recipe was the fix.
analyses.4: Nine trials all scored exactly 0 on dev, and none had any successful builds in the last 10% of training either. The failures span five architectures (footprint pooling, layer-resolved heads, a plain residual CNN, a transformer, a dense action head) and recipes with 1–2 epochs, gamma 0.95–0.99 and entropy 0.003–0.01. So no tested change mattered. The cause is probably something these runs share, not capacity. The reward per placement is dense, so a myopic policy should already do fairly well: it only needs to place the brick that fills missing cells and add no extras. Two settings were never tested: a short horizon with sharp exploitation (gamma 0.9, lambda 0.8, very low entropy), and a separate critic, so that value learning stops interfering with the policy features. In this last round, all three candidates use the myopic, low-entropy recipe on three different architectures, so a single positive result would point to the recipe.
